questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which of the following is a condensation polymer?
questions.sol_text:
A condensation polymer is formed when two monomers or monomer units react with the elimination of small molecules like water (H2O), alcohol, or HCl.

Let's analyze each option:

(1) Neoprene: This is a synthetic rubber formed by addition polymerization of chloroprene (2-chloro-1,3-butadiene). It is an addition polymer, not a condensation polymer.

(2) Buna-S: This is a synthetic rubber formed by addition polymerization of butadiene and styrene monomers. It is an addition polymer, not a condensation polymer.

(3) Nylon 6, 6: This polymer is formed by the condensation reaction between hexamethylene diamine (H2N-(CH2)6-NH2) and adipic acid (HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH). During this reaction, water molecules are eliminated:

H2N-(CH2)6-NH2 + HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH → -NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)4-CO- + H2O

The reaction continues to form a long chain polymer with amide linkages (-CO-NH-), and water is eliminated at each step. Therefore, Nylon 6, 6 is a condensation polymer.

(4) Teflon: This is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) formed by addition polymerization of tetrafluoroethylene (CF2=CF2). It is an addition polymer, not a condensation polymer.

Therefore, the answer is [3] Nylon 6, 6, which is formed by condensation polymerization with the elimination of water molecules.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The polymer obtained from the following reaction is: HOOC-(CH2)4-NH2 with (i) NaNO2/H3O+ (ii) polymerisation
options: C-(CH2)4-N with O double bond to C and H to N
HNC-(CH2)4-C-N with O double bond to first C and O double bond to second C and H to N
OC-(CH2)4-O with O double bond to C
O-(CH2)4-C-N with O double bond to C
questions.sol_text:
The starting material is HOOC-(CH2)4-NH2, which contains both a carboxylic acid group (-COOH) and a primary amine group (-NH2).

Step 1: Treatment with NaNO2/H3O+ (Diazotization)
The primary amine (-NH2) reacts with NaNO2 in acidic conditions to form a diazonium salt: HOOC-(CH2)4-N≡N+

Step 2: Diazonium decomposition
The diazonium group (-N2+) is unstable and decomposes, losing N2 gas and being replaced by a hydroxyl group: HOOC-(CH2)4-OH

Step 3: Polymerisation
The resulting compound HOOC-(CH2)4-OH has both a carboxylic acid group and a hydroxyl group. During polymerisation, the carboxylic acid groups condense with the hydroxyl groups through esterification, forming ester linkages:

The polymer structure formed is: -O-(CH2)4-C(=O)- repeated unit

This corresponds to option (4): -O-(CH2)4-C with O double bonded to C

questions.text: The correct name of the following polymer is: [Structure shows a polymer chain with two CH3 groups attached to alternating carbons in the backbone]
questions.sol_text: To name the polymer, we need to identify the repeating unit structure. The polymer shown has a backbone with methyl (CH3) groups attached to alternating carbons. This is the repeating unit of isobutylene (2-methylpropene or isobutene): CH2=C(CH3)2. However, looking at the structure more carefully, we see CH3 groups on alternating carbons, which corresponds to the polymerization of isobutylene (CH2=C(CH3)2). When isobutylene polymerizes, it forms polyisobutylene (also called polyisobutene), where the backbone has alternating carbons with methyl substituents. Therefore, the correct name is Polyisobutylene (option 3).

questions.text: The two monomers for the synthesis of Nylon 6, 6 are (1) HOOC(CH2)4COOH, H2N(CH2)4NH2 (2) HOOC(CH2)5COOH, H2N(CH2)6NH2 (3) HOOC(CH2)5COOH, H2N(CH2)4NH2 (4) HOOC(CH2)6COOH, H2N(CH2)6NH2
questions.sol_text: Nylon 6, 6 is a Polyamide polymer which is obtained by condensation reaction between Hexamethylene diamine & adipic acid. The reaction scheme is: n [NH-(CH2)6-NH-] + [1 + n HO-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-OH] → [n HO-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-OH] - n H2O → [-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-]n (Nylon 6, 6). Hexamethylene diamine has the structure H2N(CH2)6NH2 (6 carbons in the chain between two amino groups). Adipic acid has the structure HOOC(CH2)4COOH (4 carbons in the chain between two carboxylic acid groups). Therefore, the two monomers are HOOC(CH2)4COOH and H2N(CH2)6NH2, which corresponds to option (2).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The structure of Nylon-6 is ?
questions.sol_text: Nylon-6 is a synthetic polyamide formed by the ring-opening polymerization of caprolactam. Caprolactam is a cyclic amide with a six-membered ring containing a C=O and N—H group. When caprolactam undergoes polymerization, the ring opens and the molecules link together through amide bonds (—CO—NH—) to form a linear polymer chain. The repeating unit of Nylon-6 contains a carbonyl group (C=O) linked to a nitrogen atom (N—H) with five methylene groups (CH2)5 in between, giving the structure: [C(=O)—(CH2)5—N—H]_n. This corresponds to option (4).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which of the following compounds is a constituent of the polymer [HN-C-NH-CH2]_N with a C=O double bond?
questions.sol_text:
Urea + Formaldehyde
H2N-C-NH2 + H-C-H
    ||       ||
    O       O
    ↓
+NH-C-NH-CH2+_n
    ||
    O
Urea formaldehyde resin

The polymer [HN-C-NH-CH2]_N is formed by the condensation reaction between urea and formaldehyde. The urea provides the nitrogen atoms and the carbonyl group (C=O), while formaldehyde provides the CH2 group that links the urea units together. Therefore, the constituents of this polymer are urea and formaldehyde. Since the question asks which compound is a constituent, and formaldehyde is one of the two monomers used to synthesize this urea-formaldehyde resin, the answer is formaldehyde (option 3).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Major product of the following reaction is: Cl-C(=O)-CCl + H2N-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-NH2 with (1) Et3N and (1) Free radical polymerisation
options: Polymer with Cl and N-H groups in backbone with side chain C(=O)-NH2
Polymer with Cl and N-H groups in backbone with side chain C(=O)-NH2 attached to different carbon
Polymer with Cl, C=O and N-H groups with side chain NH2
Polymer with N-H linker and side chain NH2, with Cl and C=O in backbone
questions.sol_text:
The reaction involves:

1) Initial condensation reaction:
   - The amine (H2N-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-NH2) acts as nucleophile
   - Et3N (triethylamine) is used as base to deprotonate the amine
   - The NH2 group attacks the acid chloride (acyl chloride)
   - One Cl is eliminated as chloride
   - This gives: Cl-C(=O)-NH-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-NH2
   - This is a better nucleophile due to the N-H group

2) Free radical polymerization:
   - The C=C double bond (from the acrylic acid derivative) undergoes free radical addition polymerization
   - The monomers link through the C=C bonds
   - The N-H and other functional groups remain as part of the backbone or side chains

3) The resulting polymer has:
   - Cl atoms in the backbone
   - N-H amide linkages in the backbone
   - Primary amide side chains (-C(=O)-NH2)

Therefore, option (1) is the major product.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The homopolymer formed from 4-hydroxy-butanoic acid is :
options: C—(CH2)2—C with O double bonds on C atoms, connected via O in repeating units
OC(CH2)3—O in repeating units with O double bond on C
C(CH2)3—O in repeating units with O double bond on C
C—(CH2)2—C with both O double bonds on C atoms in repeating units
questions.sol_text:
The monomer is 4-hydroxy-butanoic acid with structure: HO—CH2—CH2—CH2—C(=O)OH

During polymerization, the hydroxyl group (—OH) of one molecule reacts with the carboxyl group (—COOH) of another molecule through esterification.

This involves:
- Loss of water (H2O) between the —OH group and —COOH group
- Formation of an ester linkage (—O—CO—)

The resulting homopolymer has repeating units of: —O—(CH2)3—C(=O)—

This forms a polyester with the structure shown in option (3), where each repeating unit contains:
- An ester group: —O—CO—
- A three-carbon chain: (CH2)3

Therefore, the answer is option (3): [—C(=O)(CH2)3—O—]n

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which one of the following polymers is not obtained by condensation polymerisation?
questions.sol_text:
BuNa-N is an addition polymer.

Buta-1, 3-diene + Acrylonitrile
CH2=CH-CH=CH2  CH2=CH-C≡N

These monomers undergo addition polymerisation in the presence of Na catalyst to form [BuNa-N].

In addition polymerisation, monomers with C=C or C≡N bonds add directly to each other without losing any small molecule.

In contrast:
- Bakelite is formed by condensation polymerisation of phenol and formaldehyde (with loss of H2O)
- Nylon 6 is formed by condensation polymerisation of caprolactam (with loss of H2O)
- Nylon 6,6 is formed by condensation polymerisation of hexamethylenediamine and adipic acid (with loss of H2O)

Therefore, Buna-N is the only polymer obtained by addition polymerisation, not condensation polymerisation.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Consider the Assertion and Reason given below. Assertion (A): Ethane polymerized in the presence of Ziegler Natta catalyst at high temperature and pressure is used to make buckets and dustbins. Reason (R): High density polymers are closely packed and are chemically inert.
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.sol_text:
Assertion (A) is correct: Ethane undergoes polymerization in the presence of Ziegler Natta catalyst (also known as Ziegler-Natta catalyst) at high temperature and pressure to form polyethylene. High-density polyethylene (HDPE) produced this way is indeed used to manufacture buckets, dustbins, and other rigid containers due to its strength and durability.

Reason (R) is correct: High density polymers like HDPE are tightly packed with strong intermolecular forces, giving them high density. They are also chemically inert due to the strong C-C and C-H bonds, which make them resistant to corrosion and chemical attack.

Connection between (A) and (R): The reason correctly explains why ethane polymerized via Ziegler Natta catalyst is suitable for making buckets and dustbins. The process at high temperature and pressure produces high-density polyethylene, which possesses the properties mentioned in (R) - close packing and chemical inertness. These properties make it ideal for storing substances in buckets and dustbins as it won't react with the contents and is mechanically strong.

Therefore, both (A) and (R) are correct, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: The correct match between Item-I and Item-II:
questions.sol_text:
(a) Natural rubber is formed from isoprene (2-methyl-1,3-butadiene). The monomer structure is nCH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2 which polymerizes to form poly cis-isoprene (Natural rubber). This matches with (IV) Isoprene.

(b) Neoprene is formed from chloroprene (2-chloro-1,3-butadiene). The monomer structure is nCH2=C(Cl)-CH=CH2 which polymerizes to form -[CH2-C(Cl)=CH-CH2]n. This matches with (III) Chloroprene.

(c) Buna-N is formed from 1,3-butadiene and acrylonitrile. The copolymerization of nCH2=CH-CH=CH2 and nCH2=CH(CN) gives [-CH2-CH=CH-CH2-CH2-CH(CN)]n. This matches with (II) 1,3-butadiene + acrylonitrile.

(d) Buna-S is formed from 1,3-butadiene and styrene. The copolymerization of CH2=CH-CH=CH2 and CH2=CH(C6H5) gives [-CH2-CH=CH-CH2-CH2-CH(C6H5)]n. This matches with (I) 1,3-butadiene + styrene.

Therefore: (a) - (IV), (b) - (III), (c) - (II), (d) - (I)

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which polymer has 'chiral' monomer(s) ?
questions.sol_text:
PHBV : -[O-CH-CH2-C-O-CH-CH2-C-]n with CH3 below first CH, O double bonded, C2H5 below second CH, O double bonded

Monomer : CH3-*CH-CH2-COOH with OH below the starred carbon (3-Hydroxybutanoic acid) and CH3-CH2-*CH-CH2-COOH with OH below the starred carbon (3-Hydroxypentanoic acid)

Both monomers contain a chiral carbon atom (marked with *) as they have four different groups attached to them:
- 3-Hydroxybutanoic acid: The carbon bearing OH group is attached to CH3, H, OH, and CH2COOH (four different groups)
- 3-Hydroxypentanoic acid: The carbon bearing OH group is attached to CH3, CH2, H, OH, and CH2COOH (four different groups)

Nylon 6,6 is made from hexamethylenediamine and adipic acid - no chiral centers.
Neoprene is a synthetic rubber (polychloroprene) - no chiral centers in the monomer.
Buna-N is a copolymer of butadiene and acrylonitrile - no chiral centers in the monomers.

Therefore, PHBV is the only polymer with chiral monomers.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Terylene polymer is obtained by condensation of:
questions.sol_text: Terylene (polyethylene terephthalate) is a polyester formed by the condensation reaction between ethane-1,2-diol (ethylene glycol) and benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid (terephthalic acid). The two hydroxyl groups of the diol react with the two carboxylic acid groups to form ester linkages, creating the polymer chain. The para-substitution (1,4-positions) on the benzene ring is essential for terylene formation, not the meta (1,3) or ortho (1,2) isomers.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Given below are two statements, one is Assertion (A) and other is Reason (R). Assertion (A): Natural rubber is a linear polymer of isoprene called cis-polyisoprene with elastic properties. Reason (R): The cis-polyisoprene molecules consist of various chains held together by strong polar interactions with coiled structure. In the light of the above statements, choose the correct one from the options given below:
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
questions.sol_text: The cis-polyisoprene molecule consists of various chains held together by weak van der Waals interactions (not strong polar interactions) and has a coiled structure. Hence assertion is true but reason is false. The elastic properties arise from weak van der Waals interactions allowing molecular rearrangement, not strong polar interactions.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which one of the following is NOT a copolymer?
questions.sol_text: Monomer of neoprene is 2-chloro-1,3-butadiene, and it is not a copolymer. Neoprene is a homopolymer made from a single monomer. Buna-S is a copolymer of butadiene and styrene, PHBV is a copolymer, and Butadiene-styrene is a copolymer. Therefore, neoprene is the only one that is NOT a copolymer.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a natural polymer?
questions.sol_text: Rayon is a semisynthetic polymer made from cellulose through chemical processing. Proteins, starch, and rubber are all natural polymers found in nature. Therefore, rayon is NOT a natural polymer.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R. Assertion A: Dacron is an example of polyester polymer. Reason R: Dacron is made up of ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid monomers. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below.
options: Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are correct but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
A is correct but R is not correct.
A is not correct but R is correct.
questions.sol_text: Dacron is indeed a polyester polymer formed by the condensation reaction between ethylene glycol (HO-CH2-CH2-OH) and terephthalic acid (HOOC-C6H4-COOH). The reaction produces ester linkages (-O-CO-) connecting the monomers, forming the polymer chain shown in the structure. Both Assertion A and Reason R are correct, and R provides the correct chemical explanation for why Dacron is a polyester polymer.

Bakelite is a thermosetting plastic, Nylon 6,6 and Terylene are thermoplastic fibers that do not have this elastic recovery property.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Given below are two statements: Statement I: Ethane at 333 to 343 K and 6-7 atm pressure in the presence of AlEt3 and TiCl4 undergoes addition polymerization to give LDP. options: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
questions.sol_text: Statement I is FALSE: Ethane undergoes addition polymerization to give HDP (High Density Polyethylene), not LDP. LDP (Low Density Polyethylene) is formed from ethene (ethylene), not ethane. Statement II is TRUE: Caprolactam at 533-543 K in H2O undergoes step growth polymerization to give Nylon 6. This is the correct method for Nylon 6 synthesis.

questions.text: Match List-I with List-II.
questions.sol_text:
A. Elastomeric polymer - (IV) Neoprene
Elastomeric polymers are rubber-like materials with elastic properties. Neoprene is a synthetic rubber elastomer.

B. Fibre polymer - (III) Polyester
Fibre polymers are used to make fibres and textiles. Polyester is a common fibre polymer used in clothing and fabrics.

C. Thermosetting polymer - (I) Urea Formaldehyde Resin
Thermosetting polymers harden permanently when heated and cannot be remolded. Urea formaldehyde resin is a classic thermosetting polymer used in adhesives and laminates.

D. Thermoplastic - (II) Polystyrene
Thermoplastics soften on heating and can be remolded multiple times. Polystyrene is a common thermoplastic used in packaging and insulation.

Therefore, the correct matching is: A-IV, B-III, C-I, D-II

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Caprolactam when heated at high temperature in presence of water, gives
questions.sol_text:
Caprolactam is a cyclic amide (7-membered ring containing C=O and NH groups). When heated at high temperature in the presence of water, it undergoes ring-opening polymerization through hydrolysis and condensation reactions.

The structure shows:
- Caprolactam is a cyclic compound with a carbonyl (C=O) and NH group in a 7-membered ring
- Upon heating with water (hydrolysis), the ring opens
- This produces a linear polymer with the structure: -NH-(CH2)5-C(=O)- repeating unit
- This linear polyamide is Nylon 6 (also called polycaprolactam)

Nylon 6, 6 is formed from hexamethylenediamine and adipic acid (two different monomers).
Dacron is a polyester.
Teflon is a fluoropolymer.

Therefore, Caprolactam gives Nylon 6.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text:
The polymerization of ethylene to linear polyethylene is represented by the reaction
n CH₂ = CH₂ → −(CH₂ − CH₂)_n−
Given that average bond energies for C = C and C − C are 600 and 350 kJ/mol respectively. If the magnitude of enthalpy of polymerisation per mole of ethene is X kJ mol⁻¹, then the value of x/3 is
questions.sol_text:
Answer : 20.00
Solution:
Let n = 1
Then,
CH₂ = CH₂ → −(CH₂−CH₂)_n
1 double bond (C = C) is broken and net two single bonds (C — C) are formed
So ΔH = B.E(R) − B.E(P)
= B.E(C = C) − 2B.E(C−C)
= 600 − 2(350) = −100 kJ mol⁻¹

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Identify the incorrect pair from the following: (1) Polythene preparation – TiCl4, Al(CH3)3, (2) Haber process - Iron, (3) Wacker process – PtCl2, (4) Photography - AgBr
questions.sol_text: The Wacker process is used for the oxidation of ethene to acetaldehyde using PdCl2 (Palladium chloride), not PtCl2 (Platinum chloride). All other pairs are correct: (1) Polythene is prepared using Ziegler-Natta catalysts like TiCl4 and Al(CH3)3, (2) Haber process uses Iron as a catalyst, (4) Silver bromide (AgBr) is used in photography.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.text: Given below are two statements: Statement I: Wet cotton clothes made of cellulose based carbohydrate takes comparatively longer time to get dried than wet nylon polymer based clothes. Statement II: Intermolecular hydrogen bonding with water molecule is more in nylon-based clothes than in the case of cotton clothes. In the light of above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below
options: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
questions.sol_text: Statement I is TRUE: Cotton (cellulose) is hydrophilic and absorbs more water through hydrogen bonding, taking longer to dry compared to nylon which is hydrophobic and absorbs less water. Statement II is FALSE: Cotton forms MORE intermolecular hydrogen bonds with water molecules than nylon because cotton contains -OH groups (cellulose) while nylon has fewer polar sites. The correct answer is option 4: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
